skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Threatens a single target, causing it to [Break] for 2 rounds (decreases DMG Rate by 20%), and recovers 20% ATK of HP.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Heals all allies by 150% of King's max HP, and grants allies in the same row [Specialized Berserk] (the first strike deals Berserk DMG equal to 50% of King's max HP, with a chance to Crit, consuming 150 points of Energy Gauge per enemy hit), lasting 1 round.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Healing — additional 100% max HP of [Specialized Guard]Same row → All alliesBerserk DMG 50% → 150%Energy Gauge consumed 150 → 100

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, allies in the same row gain 3 rounds of [Overflow Recovery] (excess HP from Heal and Drain turns into an equivalent amount of [Life Shield]; accumulated DMG removed cannot exceed 20x his original HP). Heals by 450% of King's max HP.Before any character acts, removes [Paralysis] from himself and allies in the same row.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Heals 450% → 600%Before actions — also removes [Adhesion] from himself and all allies in the same row

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: After any ally acts, King and allies in the same row perform [Combo Follow-up] (100% DMG and 100% effect of Ultimate skill, random targets, not affected by Hit/Res), once per round. Allies in the same row share 50% Direct DMG with King. Shared DMG is reduced by 50%, cannot share DMG when HP is below 30%

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Combo Follow-up DMG 100% > 150% Perform Combo Follow-up once in first round > twice in first round Allies same row share DMG 50% > 60% Shared DMG reduction 50% > 80%

effects.desc: Control status prevents the target from casting [Follow-up] and [Consecutive Follow-up], usually for 2 turns.
Converts excess Health from healing and lifesteal into an equivalent Health Shield, up to a limit based on base Health.
